newsitem.title: UK: UK blue chips open firmer as Dow, T-bonds bounce.
newsitem.headline: UK blue chips open firmer as Dow, T-bonds bounce.

text.p: LONDON, Jan 2 (reuter) - Leading UK shares rebounded at the open on Friday, tracking a dramatic recovery in U.S. shares overnight. At 0843 GMT, the benchmark FTSE 100 was up 11.0 points to 4,068.4 after stumbling 61.1 points, or about 1.5 percent, on Thursday. The Dow, down about 60 points when London markets closed on Thursday, finished just 5.78 points lower at 6,442.49 as Treasuries recovered.
